reason: Both answers recommend a Postgres-backed queue and are factually sound. Both cover transactional enqueue, no new infrastructure, using a library, bloat and autovacuum, and SQS's 15-minute delay limit. A better explains when Redis or SQS is the right choice (Lambda, cross-service, latency, burst). B adds PgBouncer, connection-pool, idempotency and revisit-trigger guidance. Each extra would change what the asker does, so quality is comparable.
